mathematical_audit.hermite_identities: Direct symbolic simplification verifies both rational exact-derivative identities. The displayed change matrices have determinants 6 and -6, so they preserve the local generated ideal at every prime outside 6(2q-3).
mathematical_audit.support_scope: Because 2q-3 is the first factor of P_q, the adjacent-coefficient reduction is sufficient for support outside 6P_q and makes no claim at the excluded factors.
mathematical_audit.algebraic_kernels: The Lagrange-residue diagonal formula yields the two degree-at-most-six kernel equations and the four direct actual-row generating functions. Algebraicity gives recurrence structure but not coefficientwise gcd support.
mathematical_audit.cayley_reduction: For p=6m+q, q>=5, alpha is congruent to -(4m+1) modulo p. The binomial truncation and Cayley residue transformation give the stated R and S adjacent coefficients, and vanishing of the original four coordinates is equivalent to simultaneous vanishing of both adjacent pairs.
mathematical_audit.open_boundary: The lower-triangular multiplication S=R(1+z)^(-k) does not determine its last two coefficients from only the last two coefficients of R. The four-adjacent nonvanishing statement remains open, as does primitive G support.
mathematical_audit.capacity: H-only success has no separately bookable numerical effect because primitive G may occupy the combined large-prime ceiling. Full unmarked H/G support is a strong sufficient Closer result and adds no divisor lower bound; in q=1 mod 6 the minimal original target is only the distinguished cube-root branch.
